sub_strands.name: Differential Calculus and Applications
performance_indicators: Differentiate polynomial functions from first principles.
Apply the product, quotient, and chain rules to determine derivatives of complex functions.
Locate stationary points on a curve and determine their nature using the second derivative test.

sub_strands.name: Integral Calculus Foundations
performance_indicators: Evaluate indefinite and definite integrals of simple polynomial functions.
Calculate the exact area bounded by a curve, the x-axis, and given vertical coordinates.

sub_strands.name: Complex Numbers and Vectors in 3D
performance_indicators: Perform basic arithmetic operations on complex numbers in algebraic form ($a + bi$).
Represent complex numbers geometrically on an Argand diagram.
Determine the scalar product and vector product of two vectors in three-dimensional space.

sub_strands.name: Alkanes, Alkenes, Alkynes, and Reaction Rates
performance_indicators: Nomenclature and structural isolation of hydrocarbons up to six carbon atoms using IUPAC rules.
Investigate factors affecting rates of chemical reactions (concentration, temperature, catalysts).
Draw energy level diagrams to represent exothermic and endothermic chemical processes.

sub_strands.name: Equilibrium Constants and Electrochemical Cells
performance_indicators: State Le Chatelier's principle and apply it to deduce shifts in dynamic equilibrium systems.
Construct standard electrochemical cells and calculate the electromotive force ($E^	heta$) from standard electrode potentials.

sub_strands.name: Uniform Circular Motion and Gravitation
performance_indicators: Derive and apply expressions for centripetal acceleration and centripetal force ($F =  rac{mv^2}{r}$).
Apply Newton's Law of Universal Gravitation to calculate gravitational field strength at planetary boundaries.
Solve problems involving orbital velocity and escape velocity thresholds for satellites.

sub_strands.name: Electric Fields, Capacitance, and Magnetic Force
performance_indicators: Apply Coulomb's law to determine electrostatic forces between point charges.
Calculate the capacitance and total energy stored within parallel plate capacitor networks.
Investigate magnetic forces acting on current-carrying conductors inside uniform magnetic fields.

sub_strands.name: Photosynthesis and Respiration Structures
performance_indicators: Trace the biochemical steps of the light-dependent and light-independent stages of photosynthesis.
Contrast aerobic and anaerobic respiration pathways, mapping ATP yields per glucose molecule.
Investigate the mechanism of thermoregulation and osmoregulation in mammalian bodies.

sub_strands.name: Endocrine System and Plant Hormones
performance_indicators: Explain the role of major endocrine glands and human hormones in maintaining homeostatic balance.
Analyze the effects of auxins, gibberellins, and cytokinins on plant growth movements.

sub_strands.name: Classes, Objects, and Inheritance
performance_indicators: Design and implement custom classes containing attributes and methods in an OOP language.
Apply encapsulation and inheritance principles to construct reusable software objects.
Handle exceptions and runtime logic errors using structured try-catch validation blocks.

sub_strands.name: Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)
performance_indicators: Create context diagrams and data flow diagrams (DFDs) to model operational software workflows.
Draft standard system requirement specifications (SRS) for a client-server web application setup.

sub_strands.name: Technical Reports and Rhetorical Syntaxes
performance_indicators: Draft complete scientific research papers featuring hypothesis testing, abstracts, and proper APA citations.
Deliver persuasive technical presentations using complex visual models and data visualization summaries.

sub_strands.name: Uandishi wa Tasnifu na Uhakiki wa Kina
performance_indicators: Kuandika mukhtasari wa utafiti wa kisayansi na ripoti za miradi kwa lugha sanifu ya kiakademia.
Kuchambua miundo changamano ya lugha na matumizi ya tamathali za usemi katika makala ya kitaaluma.
